# Stacked computed matches

The six original `.bend` files are unchanged Apache-2.0 fixtures from
[bendlang/bend at e6676b0](https://github.com/bendlang/bend/tree/e6676b080f25b1bc1bf5b5b7d7a17e22f8022599/tests/flatten).
Original comments and golden normal forms are retained. The 39 application rows
cover the selected finite grid, not all constructor depths. New observation and
IO wrappers use MPL-2.0. Constructor projection supplies no parity credit for
the separately unresolved imported-constructor printing discrepancy.
